notes: Defined core story set for MAINT-DIST covering contract, logic, integration, and tests.

MAINT-DIST-S1.title: Define Distance Calculation Schema and Contract
MAINT-DIST-S1.description: Define input/output contract for distance calculation including coordinates (lat/long), units (miles/km), and response structure (distance, duration optional). Align with existing Google Routes response patterns.

MAINT-DIST-S2.title: Implement Core Distance Computation Logic
MAINT-DIST-S2.description: Implement backend service to compute distance between two coordinate pairs using Google Routes logic or equivalent abstraction. Normalize output and handle missing/invalid coordinates.

MAINT-DIST-S3.title: Integrate Distance Calculation into Domain Services
MAINT-DIST-S3.description: Integrate reusable distance calculation into relevant services (e.g., clinical trials and provider search) to ensure consistent distance computation across features.

MAINT-DIST-S4.title: Distance Calculation Unit and Integration Tests
MAINT-DIST-S4.description: Create unit tests for coordinate validation and distance accuracy, plus integration tests validating usage within clinical trials service flows.

MAINT-DIST.mitigation: Reuse existing Google Routes logic already implemented to avoid new external dependencies.
